GraceDeployment.Target: A local Go executable built from ./cmd/trainings-logger, running in an interactive terminal with a writable operating-system user configuration directory.
GraceDeployment.Notes: Deployment applies to local executable distribution. A GitHub Actions v* tag workflow runs GoReleaser for linux/darwin/windows on amd64/arm64 and publishes release artifacts named for trainings-logger. Binary archives contain the executable and LICENSE, with README files excluded. A required public repository variable DROPBOX_APP_KEY is embedded through Go linker flags; the executable uses the build-time value directly. No hosted application service is configured. A single initial SQLite migration is embedded from migrations/sqlite and applied on database open. It creates seven application tables for the catalog, whole-workout sessions, performances, sets, preferences, identities and credentials on fresh databases; previous incremental migration files were removed. Existing databases with the old migration history require separate handling and are not automatically reset. New migration filenames are generated with the golang-migrate CLI using the real clock. The database uses foreign keys, WAL mode, a 5000 ms busy timeout, and a single open connection. Further packaging and rollback procedures are not yet specified.
